# `storage/StorageCoordination.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/storage/StorageCoordination.js`

Same-origin storage coordination shared by tabs and workers. BroadcastChannel transports post-write events; Web Locks serializes cooperating mutations. General mutations support a local queue; Realm head reservations require native cross-context locks and never use that fallback.

## Functions

### `async withRealmLocalHeadWriteReservation(accountId, operation)`

Cooperative legacy-writer exclusion for the two Realm control-head services. The StorageManager supplies the account from its private issued scope, never a request field. Shared writers may coexist but still serialize under the existing global mutation lock; an exclusive owner blocks every legacy writer. Acquire this guard BEFORE global mutation exclusion and retain it through the entire operation, including readback and rejected completion. There is no queue, local fallback, owner bypass, or observation/provider authority here.
